formal_statement: ∀ m n : ℕ, 3 ≤ m → PEqualNP.Gct.HasDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → 2 * m ^ 2 + 11 ≤ 3 * n + 10 * m
plain_statement: Every determinantal expression of perm_m over C, m >= 3, has size n with 3n >= 2m^2 - 10m + 11. Assembly of L-gct-035 (checked), L-gct-062 (reduction at J - mE_11) and L-gct-061 (Fermat lemma, proved on paper from Kneser for codes, Mirandola-Zemor 2015 Thm 3.3). The real case (m-1)^2+1 was claimed in 2015 (arXiv 1504.00151).
title: TARGET: dc(perm_m) >= (2m^2 - 10m + 11)/3 over C, past Mignon-Ressayre m^2/2 for m >= 20
